title: Review: filesystem block store backend
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — the .tmp race is real but low-probability (requires concurrent same-CID ingests); missing soft cap means disk-full fails silently with generic errors; missing RUNBOOK leaves operators without sizing guidance.
Confidence: 80% chance of no missed bug. Uncertainty: didn't test concurrent same-CID puts in practice (the .tmp race is theoretical); filesystem error injection (ENOSPC, EROFS) not tested. Would raise confidence with a concurrent-puts stress test and a test that simulates ENOSPC during rename.
